What is new

Made-up highlights.

Backward-incompatible changes

Acme Cloudcam

The camera platform no longer accepts an entity_id under stream; set it on the entry instead.

(acme_cloudcam docs)

Acme Doorbell

Ring events now fire once per press, not once per chime.

(acme_doorbell docs)

Climate

The preset_modes attribute is now always a list for every entity_id.

(climate docs)

Group

The all_on option of light groups changes its default.

(group docs)

Acme Hub

The legacy_polling option is no longer read; polling now follows the device.

(acme_hub docs)

Acme Zigbee

Each Acme Zigbee groupGroups are a way to organize your entities into a single unit. [Learn more] now reports its members in order. If automations Automations in Home Assistant allow you to automatically respond to things that happen. [Learn more] use acme_zigbee.members, check the order.

(@example) (Acme Zigbee documentation)

Acme TV

The source list of Acme TV players is sorted by name.

(acme_tv docs)
